instruction_summary: Apply exactly the twelve bounded audit-conformance corrections to the two completed follow-up studies of Besley-Persson 2009 (001 living-update, 002 theory-update), editing their files in place, with no verdict word changes; log every old->new in results/card_corrections.csv.

steps.description: Read replication/audit artifacts, both studies' cards/reports/findings/summaries, and staged PDFs; rebuilt venv (replication venv gone)
steps.command: uv venv /workspace/.venv; uv pip install pandas==3.1.1 numpy statsmodels==0.15 pyreadstat openpyxl matplotlib scipy pypdf

steps.description: 001-C2/C5: read AER paper.pdf Tables 1-2 (pp.1237-1238) to verify printed war/parl cells and the T2 0.555*** star
001-C1: read WP nber_w13028_2007.pdf Tables 1-2 (pp.40-41, regional-FE spec) and fn17 (p.26) for the cross-check column
001-C2: rewrote printed_AER block of anchors_printed.json (T1 war c3/c4, T2 war c1-c4 order, filled SEs, pending-deposit tags on T1c2 & T2c2)

001-C1/C3/C4/C6: filled WP cross-check column + reading note (findings.md); restored identification sentence (card note 5); carried X0-between into headline (card/findings/report); added pre-1950 read route + A4 (e_polity2 to 1789) line (findings.md)
steps.command: edits + verify e_polity2 earliest year=1789 from vdem_core.csv

steps.description: 001-C7: implemented R-legor pooled attenuation arm in verdicts.py and re-ran; all 16 scorecard verdict words unchanged; arm non-binding (X0-within atten=True but joint-persists fails)
001-C8: added 'caveat'=descriptive(contemporaneous-war caveat) column to X2 rows of table1_update.csv (84) and table2_update.csv (56); numeric values preserved exactly
002-C2: fixed half_label (drop missing-income from halves) in estimate_002.py and re-ran; E2 low-half common p 0.0736->0.0395; Q1 verdict unchanged (stable); regenerated complementarity figure

002-C1/C3/C4: era-by-era absence-framing (report.md + summary); SPEC-CHOICE era-boundary label on card M1; Q3 coverage sentence (116 vs 169) on report/findings/card; erratum + true low-half values filed
Built the two correction figures and wrote 003 deliverables

key_results.001_C7_legor_attenuation: non-binding: pooled German+Scandinavian median std beta 0.252/0.098/0.258/0.131 (X0b/X0w/X1b/X1w) vs half-anchor 0.099; only X0-within atten=True and that cell is mixed(split), so the persists clause never fires
key_results.001_C2_printed_fixes: T1 war c3 0.598->0.029(0.209) ns; T1 war c4 null->0.576(0.170)***; T2 war reordered to 0.762/0.598/0.579/0.555 (all ***); SEs filled; T1c2 & T2c2 tagged pending-deposit
key_results.001_C1_WP_crosscheck: filled from w13028 Tables 1-2 (regional-FE spec); corroborates merited stars on rows 2/3/8, printed-via-different-numbers on 5/6/7/9/10/11/12; fn17 WP also prints sd 0.73 (uncorrected); adjudication stays pending-deposit
key_results.002_C2_E2_lowhalf: clean p=0.0395 (significant), n=71, r=0.2806 (was p=0.0736 marginal, n=77, r=0.2151); Q1 verdict unchanged (stable, pooled E2-vs-E0 p=0.220)

comparison_to_original.note: 001-C2 misattribution corrected against the AER PDF

comparison_to_original.original: c1=0.555** , c2=0.762*** (two cells, out of order)
comparison_to_original.note: 001-C2 order fixed + SEs filled; 001-C5 fixes the 0.555** -> 0.555*** star in the summary

comparison_to_original.original: persists / persists / mixed(split) / persists ... (no attenuation arm run)
comparison_to_original.followup: identical verdict words; pooled attenuation arm now run and recorded as non-binding
comparison_to_original.note: 001-C7: audit said the arm is non-binding - confirmed, all 16 words unchanged
002-C2: half_label dropped NaN-income countries from the low half; Q1 verdict unchanged (stable)
unchanged - the test is on the pooled sample, not the halves

deviations: Edited the two prior studies' files in place, as the instruction's deliverable requires ('corrected files in place'); kept full pre-correction backups under workspace/backups/. Did not touch /workspace/eval/replication/, analyze/, verify/, report/.
No separate AER PDF was staged; the AER published article is /workspace/inputs/paper.pdf (VOL. 99 NO. 4, Tables 1-2 pp.1237-1238), used as the printed-cell source of truth for 001-C2/C5.

001-C1: the WP (w13028) Tables 1-2 are the regional-fixed-effects (within) spec, so the cross-check is star-pattern evidence, not a cell-for-cell match; every suspect cell stays pending-deposit (Branch R). Stated on the surface.
